Basing on the principle and aim of constructing learning regional innovation system and the characteristic of learning region, this article mainly focuses on the composing of learning regional innovation system which consists of the knowledge creation system,the regional learning system, the knowledge flow system, the technical innovation environment system and the innovation performance system and discusses its circulating mechanism. At last some countermeasures are put forward to provide reasonable reference for the future development of Chinese learning regional innovation system.

articleTitle: Modeling on the PA-BDI agent in rumors spreading
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The roles of individuals in an actual rumors network are different, so the rumors network is unequal. And the authoritative individual who has public authority (PA) has a significant impact on others. This paper proposes the PA-BDI model based on public authority and BDI model, and study the model structure and the reasoning process for individuals in unequal rumors networks. With the help of Anylogic, the actual course of rumor spreading is simulated based on the individual model of PA-BDI. Simulation experiment takes the event that citizens rush to purchase salt owning to Japanese Earthquake into consideration. The result of experiment indicates that the simulation can generally fit the actual event on the whole. Therefore, the PA-BDI model and the simulation in this paper can reflect the action of individuals in the network of rumor spreading.

articleTitle: Study on the technology innovation of volcanic rocks petroleum fracturing in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper makes use of experimental research methods to explore the important impact on the volcanic rocks fracturing to petroleum exploration innovation. The experiment carried out in the Daqing Oilfield Co.Ltd. Production Engineering Research Institute, and a number of experts and laboratory personnel have completed the experimental task. The existing literature at home and abroad on the volcanic oil fracturing technology research is very little, and the paper is to do some exploration about the petroleum fracturing technology. It detailedly integrates the geological engineering data, sets up effective KID library, refers TRIZ methods to resolve problems, and uses computer software programming to determine six types of G fuction characteristics and four quantitative characterististic parameters of the volcanic, and then according to the material-field analysis builds the Daqing volcanic condition diagnosis model and last develops the volcanic fracturing design construction assisted analysis system. Finally, Orioles 2 deep well 173 III layer is verified the validity of the experimental methods and the accuracy of the experimental procedures with a view to the benefits of the future development of the oil industry and the volcanic exploration technology innovation.

articleTitle: Model research on tacit knowledge coupling of complex major scientific project
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: One of the core goals of strategy of complex major scientific projects is promoting coupling innovation of different tacit knowledge. In order to effectively realize coupling innovation of different tacit knowledge, we firstly applied Knowledge management theory to define the scientific content of coupling of tacit knowledge in complex major scientific projects and analyze necessity of coupling of tacit knowledge. Then, based on differential dynamics, we built coupling model of tacit knowledge in complex major scientific projects, analyzed the progressive nature of analytical solution of the model. Finally, based on the analysis of model, we proposed that the coupling innovation of different tacit knowledge in complex major scientific projects could be accelerated by improving the knowledge management system, establishing assessment and incentive mechanism of coupling innovation of tacit knowledge and creating coupling innovation environment of tacit knowledge.

articleTitle: Ownership structure adjustment and labor concentration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Taking from the agglomeration theory and reality of labor force in the industrial sector, this paper makes two concentration indexes— the raw geographic concentration index and the location quotient index — in urban and rural ownership departments, to analyze the trend of urban and rural ownership departments' ability to absorb labor force elements. The results of measurement verifies that the transformation in pattern of ownership with fast development of non-public-owned economies as its main feature is the origin of labor force flowing in large-scale between urban and rural areas, and among regional industries since the reform and opening up.

articleTitle: Traditional marketing channel VS network marketing channel: A multi-market competition model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper analyses the competition relationship between two markets, the traditional marketing channels market and the network marketing channels market. Then, on based on the Bowley model and introduction of the cooperation coefficient, we establish an improved multi-market competition model of two firms competing in two relevant markets. By calculating the numerical solution, to obtain the revenue maximization, this paper discusses what quantity of the product the firm should put into and sales in each channel market, at what price should to be sold, and how to maximize the profits. Finally, we analyzed the multi-market competition and tacit collusion using the static analysis method.

articleTitle: The mediating effects of psychological empowerment on leadership style and employee satisfaction in hospitals
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This research was aimed at examining psychological empowerment in mediating the relation between transformational leadership and employee satisfaction. With the method of questionnaire, 1252 medical staffs in Shanghai were investigated and data analysis tools were SPSS 16.0 and AMOS 17.0. The results indicated that, to some extent, psychological empowerment mediated the relation between transformational leadership and employee satisfaction. Meaning, competence and impact mediated the relation between visionary motivation and employee satisfaction, while only meaning between moral modeling and employee satisfaction.

articleTitle: Recessive, dominant and direct situation of home products consciousness—Based on the theory of social approval
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the theory of social approval, this paper divides the home products consciousness into recessive, dominant and the direct situation. With college students as samples, this paper investigate their three situations of the home products consciousness. Through the statistical analysis and tests, The result shows the relationship between the patriotic emotion of direct situation and domestics preference of dominant situation is not evident; the relationship between the domestics preference of recessive situation and domestics preference of dominant situation is not evident; the relationship between the patriotic emotion of direct situation and domestics preference of recessive situation is negative correlation. Finally, this paper discusses the results of research, and points out the theoretical contributions, limitations of the research and the direction of the research in the future.

articleTitle: Intellectual capital integration and its dynamic development mechanism research
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the knowledge economy, the intellectual capital which has replaced the traditional production elements becomes the most important strategic resources of enterprise. This change will inevitably influence the original evolution theory of core ability. Based on the theory of enterprise resource and integration theory, we proposed a new perspective that effectively integrated intellectual capital constitute enterprise core ability. After explained the hierarchical relationships between intellectual capital and core ability, this article puts forward an intellectual capital integration model and an intellectual capital dynamic development model, and finally gives the corresponding empirical research. The conclusions are that intelligence capital is the foundation of core ability, and during the formation of intelligence capital human capital plays a key role. As one of the factors of intellectual capital, capital structure is the strongest influence factor of core ability.

articleTitle: The influence factors on Chinese tax growth of analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper the main factors that affect our revenue growth from both qualitative and quantitative point of view. In the quantitative analysis, we using of EVIEWS6.0 software, collecting 1990–2009 data, to empirical analysis the economic factors (mainly including gross domestic product, the financial expenditure and the retail price index) which affect our revenue growth, has been gotten the multiple linear regression model of the impacts of China's tax revenue growth. And then we use the model to validate the 2010 tax income of our country.

articleTitle: Application of TOPSIS in evaluating public crisis management capability under a fuzzy environment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper develops an evaluation approach based on the Technique for Order Performance by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS), to evaluate the government's crisis management capability in a fuzzy environment where the vagueness and subjectivity are handled with linguistic terms parameterized by triangular fuzzy numbers. This study applies the fuzzy multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) method to determine the importance weights of evaluation criteria and to synthesize the ratings of crisis event. Aggregated the evaluators' attitude toward preference; then TOPSIS is employed to obtain a crisp overall capability value for each alternative to make a final decision. This approach is demonstrated with a real case study involving 9 evaluation criteria, 4 crisis event assessed by 4 evaluators. And the case study demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Study on transfer pricing strategy of intermediate products for Multinational Corporation (MNC): Tax avoidance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Given the context of economic globalization, the free flowing of capital and technology among the open markets is the common status for the current cross-nation economic connections. That Multinational Corporations (MNCs) have established subsidiaries in different countries and markets is the main manifestation of the free flowing of capital and technology. Undoubtedly, pricing the intermediate products which flow among the subsidiaries is one of the main decision-making goals. But the differences in each county's tax rate weighs considerably important when MNC are pricing the intermediate products of their subsidiaries. This paper, based on the linear demand functions and no external market existing in intermediate products of subsidiaries, first introduces differential tax rates of different markets and economies into MNC's intermediate product pricing. Then it does some studies on transfer pricing methods of intermediate products and finally comes to the conclusion that MNC is able to reach reasonable tax avoidance and its corporation's overall profits maximization by the transfer pricing method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis on share ownership transfer of public-private partnerships (PPPs) in infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper studied the share ownership transfer of PPPs in infrastructure industry, as soon as possible to break complexion of low efficiency. The paper handled two-stages game analysis, constituted the model of share ownership transfer of PPPs, and took public share ownership sell to private department and individual investor, so as to activate a great deal of private capital for infrastructure by small amounts of state-owned capital, induct market competition mechanism for infrastructure industry, reduce pressure of government investment, and develop the industry.

articleTitle: Web-services based model management in e-commerce recommender systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to deal with diverse services that run on heterogeneous platforms and a variety of environments, we present the design and implementation of an intelligent Multi-agent framework with web-services for e-commerce recommendation. To facilitate distributed recommendation with collaborative algorithms, web-services based architecture with multi-agent for e-commerce environment is designed and developed. In this architecture, we combined a two-type recommender model based on model transformation and presented a service control flow based on intelligent agents. The aim of this framework is to present optimal solutions to enhance and facilitate e-commerce services in distributed environment. At last, a sample implementation using JAVA was conducted.

articleTitle: Energy consumption, carbon emissions and economic growth: An empirical analysis of China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of energy consumption and carbon emissions in China during the period of 1978–2005. We examine the Granger causality relationships between economic growth, energy consumption and carbon emissions. We find that there only has unidirectional Granger causality between economic growth, energy consumption and carbon emissions in China. It means that energy consumption and carbon emissions are not the Granger causality of economic growth, but economic growth is the Granger causality of energy consumption and carbon emissions. In the end, we provide some advices about energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Peak-to-peak robust tracking control for improved disequilibrium cobweb model with multiple time delay effects
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper proposes a novel design framework of tracking control based on a class of improved disequilibrium cobweb models with exogenous perturbations and multiple time delay states. From the viewpoint of economic control theory, the expected price is designed as a control variable, dynamic feedback control method is used to study the stability of disequilibrium market, the controllability of the market price and the tracking performance of the error between demand and supply. For the considered complex nonlinear cobweb models with perturbations and time delay effects, convex linear matrix inequality (LMI) optimization algorithms and Lyapunov-Krasovskii stability analyzed methods are used to design a generalized feedback controller such that stability of market prices, and tracking performance of the error between demand and supply can be guaranteed. Furthermore, in order to enhance the robustness, the peak-to-peak measure index is applied to optimize the tracking performance. Simulation results show the proposed dynamic approach is effective and adaptable for economic reality.

articleTitle: Study on the status and performance of specialization development in the Binhai New Area and the Yellow River basin
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper focuses on the main economic data of the major industrial sectors in the Tianjin Binhai New Area and the nine provinces along the Yellow River over the years. Based on the current specialization status and level of the major industrial sectors in the Binhai New Area and the Yellow River Basin, and combining relevant principles like international trade, industrial clustering, regional specialization with economic indicators like Krugman coefficient (regional division of labor index), non-parametric Malmquist productivity index, this paper analyses and compares the specialization level in the Binhai New Area and the Yellow River basin over the same period, discusses the influence of specialization on the regional economic development and further explores the possibility of competition and development of regional economy under the specialization level in the Binhai New Area and the Yellow River basin.

articleTitle: The empirical research of controlling shareholders' propping: Based on the relevant provisions of the system about “delisted warning companies” and “suspending listing companies”
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper selects the listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen market as samples which deficit only one year since 2005. According to the years of sustained losses in the subsequent years, these samples can be divided into “companies facing delisted warning” <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,2</sup> and “companies suspending listing” <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Then this paper analyzes and researches the propping of controlling shareholders by paired analysis. The empirical research not only proves the objective existence of controlling shareholders' propping, but also research variables influence on controlling shareholders' propping differently between this two types of companies. The research results suggest that if the listed companies controlled by government, especially by local government, the higher the proportion of the largest shareholder is, the higher the proportion of the employment rate is, and the better the government environment is, then the higher level of propping the controlling shareholders will be. Especially, when listed companies facing “suspending listing”, the effect of these variables on controlling shareholders' propping will be more notable than that of companies facing delisted risk warning.

articleTitle: The effect of green trade barriers on China's vegetable exports
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the increasing agricultural trade disputes with the developed countries, China's exports have more constrained by Green-trade barriers. The vegetables are the most effected agricultural products by the technical standards of residue (Chlorpyrifos MRL).The study estimated the impact levels of Green-trade barriers to China's vegetable export by using a gravity model panel data to be assessed through targeted 18 major countries and regions of China vegetable export in regression analyses. The results showed that the technical standards imposed by importing countries had both negative and positive effect on China's Vegetable export. It should decrease the quantities of export. It could also increase the export price and increase the export amount. Finally, gave conclusion and put forward policy implications.

articleTitle: The evolution of product-service system business model: A case study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The global green economy transition calls for the transformation of business strategy from traditional product-oriented business model to service-oriented business model. This new business model is product-service system. Although there is rich research around PSS business model, but most of those research is based on the static perspective, the transforming process of PSS business model is an area that be ignored. This paper makes the analysis on PSS business model base on the dynamic perspective. The evolution route of PSS business model is combined with the growth process of the enterprises, and the factors that induce the evolution are analyzed. An entrepreneurial firms as a case is analyzed around the evolution route, influencing factors, innovation types, which prove the dynamics does exist in PSS business model.

articleTitle: A study on measuring urbanization process drag from urban-rural digital divide in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Informatization is a great motivity to urbanization, but urbanization process is seriously cumbered by urban-rural digital divide in China. Romer's theory of economy growth drag is used for reference, and non-linear regression is applied to build a model of measuring the urbanization process drag from China's urban-rural digital divide. As a research result, the formula of measuring drag is deduced. The China's urbanization process drag is determined not only by urban-rural digital divide but also by industry structure, population diathesis and life quality. It implies that the urbanization process drag from China's urban-rural digital divide is not an oversimplified problem of information technology permeation, but a complicated socioeconomic problem. This study can help government to make some systemic measures to use informatization to drive urbanization process.

articleTitle: Bayesian analysis of the risk management of China's futures markets—A Tobit-GJR-GARCH model based study
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Taking daily price limits into account and supposing that the information is asymmetric on China's futures markets, this paper constructs a Two-limit Tobit-GJR-GARCH model, and carries out Bayesian analysis by means of Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate the VaR and CVaR of the active trading commodities (e.g. soybean oil, copper and sugar) on China's futures markets. Empirical evidence indicates that daily price limits have important impacts on the risk measure and the theoretical margin of commodities with larger volatility. It is easy to underestimate the risk without regard to the impact of price limits, and the theoretical margin may not be able to cover the market risk. It will be more reliable to measure the risk and determine the theoretical margin based on the Tobit-GJR-Garch model which considers the impact of price limits, and the method provided in the paper accord with the actual situation and may be applied to the risk management of China's futures markets.

articleTitle: An analysis on the coordination development mechanism of the industrial structure and the employment structure in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper makes the empirical analysis of the developing trend, three decades of industrial structure and employment structure of Hebei Province. It expounds the cause of in coordination between interactive development of industrial structure and employment structure of Hebei Province, from the employment elastic coefficient, structure departure degree, relative labor productivity and so on. The coordination development mechanism and its way of industrial structure and employment structure was put forward, in the macroeconomic environment of transformation form and adjust structure during the 12th Five-Year Plan period in China.

articleTitle: The recognition and application of FDI motivation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The motivation of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) determines its spillover channel in host countries. If FDI is concentrating on local markets in host countries, the technology spillover it brings about is horizontal. If FDI is export-oriented, the spillover is vertical. As to host countries, vertical FDI is more popular than horizontal FDI because the former could bring more effects to local enterprises. Recent studies have shown that FDI transfers pollution industries to host countries to evade home countries' strict environmental policies. Then it expands import from host countries which substitutes polluting production in home countries. This causes the phenomenon of “pollution space transfer” in China. This article proposes an index to distinguish FDI's motivation and applies it in China's industry. The result demonstrates that most of our country's export-orientation FDI is released into intense carbon emission industries<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>. This phenomenon testifies the hypothesis of China as “contamination shelter”. Accordingly China should introduce export-oriented clean industry positively and enhance environmental regulation standard to attract superior FDI.

articleTitle: An empirical study on measurement of transmission lagging effect of monetary policy on the stock market
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper analyzes the transmission effect of monetary policy on the stock market using a structure vector auto-regression model and thus computes the lagging period of the effect. We employ four variables including lending rate, deposit-reserve ratio, money supply and the deposit rate. After the ADF test and co-integration test, the paper conducts the impulse response analysis and draws each variable's impulse response figures. Then we use the variance decomposition to detect the lagging period and each variable's contribution level in affecting the stock market. The findings suggest that there exist transmission lagging effects; in particular, the variable M2's effect on the stock market is more stable and the variable deposit rate has the fastest effect on the stock market.

articleTitle: The empirical research on relationship between the industrial structure and urban evolution of the region of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The region of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei dominates the economic development in China's northern region,and its coordination between industrial structure and urban evolution is great significant to regional economy. Firstly, based on the concept of the urban evolution, the article proposes comprehensive index system of the industrial structure and urban evolution. Then, using the SAS software, with the method of factor analysis and correlation analysis, processing the 21 years' data of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the paper does empirical research on the relationship between the industrial structure and urban evolution, and assessed the interaction between the tertiary industries and urban evolution. The result shows that, the first industry plays a dynamic function, but its own development is limited, cannot be sustained upgrade; the secondary industry does not form a sound development mechanism and role in promoting the urban evolution decline; the third industry promotes the urban evolution, but there is the phenomenon of virtual sophistication.

articleTitle: The fuzzy evaluation model for opportunity choosing in engineering project bidding
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The bidding system is the main form of transaction in construction market. It is the route that must be taken when construction enterprises undertake business projects. In order to win in the intense market competition, construction enterprises must analyze the influential bidding decision factors before bidding for the project, use proper bidding strategy and method, and then make a comprehensive analysis assessment, and ultimately determine a reasonable bid opportunity. Most of these factors are fuzzy variables. It is difficult to find the accurate mathematical formula to measure their impact on bidding quotation. Because the factors of evaluation have fuzzy character, thus the evaluation process and the evaluation result are fuzzy. Fuzzy mathematics provides mathematical language and quantitative methods for quantity fuzzy problems, powerful tools for bid decision-making provide. This paper proposes a method to quantify the relationships of objects, factors in bidding construction projects based on fuzzy theory and the analysis of the representative factors in bidding opportunity decision. This model is of universal significance in application.

articleTitle: The research on influential factors of IPO short-term returns
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on data of China's IPO (Initial Public Offerings) market in recent years, this paper conducts analysis on influential factors of the IPO short-term excess returns, contrasting interpretation strength of relevant theories towards the market. It's proved by empirical evidence that the Signaling Theory plays better than the Winner Curse Theory in interpreting the short-term excess returns. In view of the imbalance between supply and demand, the our research indicates that the issuance scale contributes much to the abnormal excess returns; prediction difference among analysts also inflicts obvious influences on short-term excess returns; in view of information asymmetry, the return on average assets (ROAA), the growth rate of net profits, and the number of reports on prediction do play the same role with the issuance scale; the comparison between different boards proves that the abnormal short-term excess returns in the Main Board is not obvious as expected. However, the situation in the pioneering edition behaves more seriously.

articleTitle: The research of multisource response mechanism in post-disaster reconstruction based on Spatial Information Grid
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The Spatial Information Grid (SIG) support management, transport, distributed access, and analysis of various datasets by potentially thousands of service applicants. This paper, based on SIG, first researches on necessary analysis of multisource response mechanism in post-disaster reconstruction. Moreover, it researches on the model of multisource response mechanism in post-disaster reconstruction. There are mainly four aspects about information telecommunication: acquiring spatial information, responding spatial information, reaction spatial information and evaluation spatial information. In order to testify greater efficiency of the model, probability analysis is given. Eventually, it can be suggested as conclusion that telecommunication referring to four aspects in post-disaster reconstruction based on SIG has larger efficiency than traditional manner.

articleTitle: Design of berth scheduling based on improved particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Considering the difference of the ship's loss of waiting in berth scheduling jobs, it established an optimization model to minimize the ship's loss of waiting. And two improved PSO are designed: 1. Add perturbation to the iterative process of PSO algorithm. This method to some extent avoids the algorithm falling into the local optimal values; 2.Add the simulated annealing mechanism when it updates the particles' velocity and position. This method strengthens the global searching capability and increases the diversity of particles. The above two improvements of the algorithm and the PSO is applied to the port berth scheduling problem. Then execute the mathematical simulation and a number of computing. Comparison of algorithms' results have indicated that the hybrid PSO algorithm which adds the simulated annealing mechanism have the best performance.

articleTitle: Discussion on operational risk and financial sustainability of Beijing-Tianjin high speed railway
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: High Speed Railway (HSR) is an environmental friendly green industry. With implementation of Medium-and-long Term Railway Network Plan, investment scale of railway construction in China expanded continuously. Other conditions kept constant, transportation volume increasing rate of High Speed Railway is lower than that of investment within certain period, which inevitably leads to the problem of railway operation risk and financial sustainability. Beijing-Tianjin Intercity HSR is the first dedicated passenger line with operation speed over 350km/h, and will confront with demand risk, competition risk, financial risk, etc., of which, financial risk refers to the risk of capital chain break and long-drawn loss. Empirical study shows that capital flow will reach balance within year set of [2020, 2024], breakeven point in 2024. Sensitivity analysis manifests that income and cost changes have minor effects on financial risk while speed value and proportion of equity-debt have significant impact. Thus, the essence of financial risk faced by Beijing-Tianjin intercity HSR and Chinese railway system lays heavily on construction scale, standard and process.

articleTitle: Study on influential factors of low-carbon performance of manufacturing green innovation system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the perspective of low-carbon, the paper analyzes three main influential factors of the low-carbon performance of China's manufacturing green innovation system, including low-carbon innovation ability of manufacturing green innovation system, low-carbon industry upgrading of manufacturing and low-carbon benefits of manufacturing. And then the paper takes China's manufacturing annual statistical data of 2006–2010 as sample data, collects quantification data of qualitative index through questionnaire, and analyzes the influence degree and the role that the three factors play in low-carbon performance of manufacturing green innovation system by using the grey relational analysis. The result shows that the three main influential factors all influence the low-carbon performance of manufacturing green innovation system significantly. Then it makes some recommendations to improve the low-carbon performance of manufacturing green innovation system.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on regional economic growth effects of national development strategies: The case of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Overall Regional Development Strategy in the Twelfth Five Year Plan indicates the central government's determination to narrow the economic development gap and to promote harmonious regional economic development. Many studies have analyzed the positive role of national development strategies, but there is not much empirical evidence on the effect of its implementation. To be able to evaluate the effect of national development strategies objectively, it is necessary to find an appropriate starting point. We start from total factor productivity (TFP), combining with Heilongjiang province's data from 1990 to 2011 and measuring changes in total factor productivity of Heilongjiang province before and after the Northeast Old Industrial Bases Revitalization Strategy by dummy variables. The result shows that the total factor productivity is a more objective indicator of regional growth effect of national development strategies. National development strategies do play a positive role in promoting regional economic growth, but the effect has not yet been fully exploited, there is further exploration to improve the efficiency.

Author Keywords: The Northeast Old Industrial Bases Revitalization Strategy

articleTitle: Empirical study on the relationship between the spatial agglomeration index and agglomeration efficiency in the textile industry
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Taking the textile industry as an example, with the help of a series of input-output indicator, this paper calculates and analyses the agglomeration trend and regional distribution of the overall Chinese textile industry, conducts the Stewart Granger causality test on the relationship between spatial agglomeration degree and agglomeration profits of the textile industries, and discovers the balanced relationship and bi-directional causality relationship between spatial agglomeration level and agglomeration profits of the whole textile industries. But from the perspective of regional analysis, some areas with higher agglomeration level has the inversion phenomenon that the cost-benefit indicator is lower than the national average, and the trends of excessive agglomeration, production factors' congestion and decreased profits can be proved from more intuitional scatter diagram. Research findings provide theoretical support on how to guide the interregional flow of production factors scientifically, how to achieve industrial gradient shift, how to optimize the resources allocation.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of regional tourism cooperation based on triangular fuzzy number
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Regional tourism cooperation is an effective measure to develop China regional economy and expand domestic demand; it has various forms and the number of regional tourism cooperation increases rapidly. However, the studies on regional tourism cooperation performance evaluation are few currently, one hand, it makes the decision-making on regional tourism cooperation have a big random, on the other hand, it makes many co-operation which have good basis for cooperation do not achieve the desired results. Therefore, complex system performance evaluation is introduced innovatively to comprehensive performance evaluation, with cooperative basis, cooperative execution, cooperative benefits and cooperative persistent four indicators from beforehand, things in, afterwards, and tracking four stages evaluate the cooperation performance using triangular fuzzy number, this will help evaluate the feasibility, operability and comprehensive benefit of the regional tourism cooperation.

articleTitle: Discussions on the real name system of internet public sphere—Based on a perfect information dynamic game model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Whether the real-name system is able to regulate network behavior and online speech in internet public sphere has been the focus of the parties to debate. In this article, on the perspective of regulators, we constructed a three-phase completed information dynamic game model, through the equilibrium solution of the game under different conditions, to analyze the necessary measures to regulate public speech environment, as well as the effectiveness of real-name system to control networks malpractice. By increasing the clearance rate of illegal information and other measures, the regulator could regulate online speech environment effectively, which does not necessarily need real-name system to achieve. The real-name system, to some extent, can play the role of regulating online speech environment, but it is not an absolutely effective mean.

articleTitle: Disclosure level, information asymmetry, cost of capital and capital structure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: By employing one-way variance analysis, signed rank tests and multivariable regression method while using the data of subsample firms in Shenzhen Stock Exchange on 31-Dec-2010, this paper verifies that the disclosure level has a negative relation with the information asymmetry, while the information asymmetry has a positive relation with the cost of capital, and the cost of capital is negatively correlated to the capital structure. Using the multivariable regression and the robustness tests in the full-sample firms, some further results indicate that the cost of capital, the information asymmetry and the disclosure levels have significant effect on the variation of firms' leverage and the firm-level factors significantly affect capital structure. This means that the pecking order theory is not adaptable in China's security market where companies prefer financing through equity capital.

articleTitle: Knowledge management for urban construction based on symbiosis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper explores knowledge formation and knowledge management for urban construction in the context of sustainable development. The primary goal of this research is to propose an approach to helping achieve the harmony and the sustainability of urban construction and development, by the research of knowledge management based on symbiosis. As the theoretical basis of this paper, the previous related studies of symbiosis and knowledge management are reviewed. In this paper, the relationship between urban construction and symbiosis is studied, and it is found that the introduction of symbiosis to urban construction can conduce to the harmonious and sustainable development of the cities. The analysis of harmonious symbiosis between urban construction project and the environment shows the complexity of symbiotic city and the necessity of knowledge management at the city level for urban construction, thus a knowledge management system for urban construction is set up, and then the elements of the system are considered using symbiosis. The Shanghai Expo Park is taken as an example of symbiotic urban renewal project, the successful knowledge management experience of its construction is discussed, and several suggestions of knowledge management for urban construction are provided according to the case study.

articleTitle: How technology management affects the development of service industries: A case study of China's telecommunications industry
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: China's telecommunications industry has been appreciably growing since many years and China now has world's largest telecommunications networks not only in terms of network capacity but also number of subscribers. This paper, aiming at investigating effects of technology management and technological capability on industrial development, lays emphasis on illustrating relationships among technology management, technological capability and telecommunications industry development and tries to explore how technology management affects industrial development. The paper argues that technological capability has the most significant effects on telecommunications industry development; technology management has more significant effects on telecommunications industry development than labor and capital. Technology management can exert influences on telecommunications industry development through technological capability, and by interacting with technological capability, effects of technology management are magnified. In the same way, technological capability has not only direct effects on industrial development, but also significant indirect effects by interacting with technology management. The findings in the paper have important managerial implications in terms of promoting technology management and technological capability for telecommunications industry to gain competitiveness, and improving synergy of technology management and technological capability to foster the development of telecommunications industry. The paper also contributes to the existing research in two different ways. First, the study demonstrates the effects of technology management at industrial level. Second, the exploration of technology management and technological capability and their interactions describes dynamics of the development of China's service industry from a new and complementary perspective.

articleTitle: Research on catch-up mode of low-carbon technology in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to cope with the global climate change and realize the carbon emission reduction targets of China, according to the significant gap of China and the developed countries in the low-carbon technological level, this paper extracts the specific content of low-carbon technology in China, reveals Chinese catch-up mode of low-carbon technology, and divides Chinese catch-up mode of low-carbon technology into three aspects, including path-following catch-up mode of low-carbon technology, phase-skipping catch-up mode of low-carbon technology and path-creating catch-up mode of low-carbon technology. Furthermore, this paper deeply analyzes the basic characteristics and technological catch-up phases of the three modes of low-carbon technology in China, finally provides the theoretical basis for the government of China to strategies making of low-carbon technological catch-up.

articleTitle: Researches on relationship between investments in fixed assets and market performance in telecommunications industry—A research based on panel data from the 31 provinces and cities
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to study the relationship between investments in fixed assets and market performance, STATA software to analyze Non-equilibrium panel data from 31 provinces and cities was proposed. The result is that, the relationship between investments in fixed assets and market performance is inverted U-shaped, too much investment in fixed assets is useless for market performance. We also found that fixed telephone subscribers pairs contribute to the market performance, while the contribution from mobile telephone subscribers and the scale of internet users is not enough.

articleTitle: Research on rural market construction in Heilongjiang
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the experienced concluded during implementation of the “Rural Market Project”, this paper discusses how to create the modern agricultural products, the agricultural means system of production and the rural consumer product circulation system and pile out a path of the construction of the characteristic rural market circulation system centering on informationization application and guided by ideological innovation.

articleTitle: Financial restatement of listed company and auditor change
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the domestic and international capital markets, financial restatement of listed company is becoming increasingly prominent, seriously affected the confidence of investors in listed companies. Based on this background, this study attempts to analysis the relationship between external auditing and financial restatements from the auditor's perspective, then, analysis risk evaluation of auditor and risk reaction for financial restatements deeply. We find, restatement companies are significantly likely to change auditor than non-restatement companies when controlling of other factors in terms; Different causes of financial restatements on auditor changes affected by the presence of significant difference. Furthermore, when the restatements are caused by earnings manipulation, Restatement Company is significantly likely to change auditor, but internal control deficiency, the complex business and accounting standards characteristics is not significant.

articleTitle: The impact of inter-organizational relationship process management on outsourcing success: Vendor's perspective
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Given the potential influence of inter-relationship process management on outsourcing success in outsourcing cooperation, and discussed the issue that outsourcing vendor can reach outsourcing success through inter-organizational process management. we adopt process theory to attempt to investigate the effect of inter-organizational relationship process management on supplier outsourcing success from vendor's perspective, grounded in available literature on outsourcing relationship and process theory as foundation, we provide empirical evidence using SEM methods to test the model, and find that relationship maintenance, continuous interaction and mutual adjustment can improve supplier's performance. The results also indicate that outsourcing supplier make actively inter-organizational relationship process management, they are capable of improving outsourcing success. The conclusion has great significance on inter-organizational relationship process management of outsourcing practice and outsourcing success.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between board diversity and firm technological innovation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the relationship between the board diversity and corporate technological innovation on the relevant data of Hi-tech industrial listed firms in China from the year 2007–2009. Main findings and conclusions of this paper are as follows: there is a positive correlation between board's functional background diversity and technological innovation, there is a positive correlation between board's educational level diversity and technological innovation, but there is no significant influence between board industrial background diversity and technological innovation.

articleTitle: E-commerce and export behavior: Evidence from Jiangxi firms
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The adoption of Internet-based B2B e-commerce applications is being promoted in the developing world as a systemic innovation which offers producer firms new exchange mechanisms that enable them to compete on a more equal basis in world markets. This paper studies how e-commerce affects export. Due to rapid growth of export and e-commerce in Jiangxi province, Jiangxi export firms were investigated mainly by questionnaire. Entrepreneurial characteristics, historical data of firms, and other firm-specific factors such as the size of operation, export intensity, investment level and wage rates were included in the analysis. The findings of the study suggest that the performance of firms in international markets has been better for those that have adopted more advanced e-business tools.

articleTitle: Renminbi exchange rate pass-through onto prices of China's agricultural exports to U.S.A. and implications for exchange rate policy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper investigates the exchange rate pass-through onto prices of China agricultural exports to markets of U.S.A. by use of unit root, cointegration tests and models under the hypothesis of asymmetry. The sample used in the paper covers the period January 1993 to January 2012. Moreover, we analyze the price discriminating behavior and currency invoicing decisions of China's agricultural exporters in the presence of menu costs. Then, the paper also examines the significant reform of Renminbi exchange rate regime in July 2005 through dividing the whole sample period into two subsample periods. The results show that the degree of appreciation the exchange rate transmission to agricultural export prices of China is more incomplete than that of depreciation. As well the menu costs exist in the transmission process from changes of Renminbi to export prices. The outcomes show that the reform in 2005 deeply changed the transmission elasticity in addition.

articleTitle: Bottleneck problem research on development mechanism of coal-based city
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, analysis strongly coal-based city economic development as the goal to define the concepts, standards and classification of the resource-based cities, coal-based city main characteristics and laws of economic development, as well as the coal industry, coal resources in the city and analyzed in terms of economic, social, resources, ecological environment and the population of five main problems facing the coal resources in China city to explore and summarize the Economic Recession of the coal resources in the city from the subjective and objective level for the study of coal resources. Urban competitiveness evaluation to improve the foundation and provide the basis for. More resource-based city and its mechanism, the bottleneck problem of the innovation of this paper is to study mechanisms.

articleTitle: The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of the flexible development of circular economy in enterprise
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: To quantitatively assess stability of circular economy, the article defines the flexible development of a circular economy in enterprise based on the enterprise flexibility and the industrial chain flexibility of a circular economy, analyzes all the internal and external factors that affect the flexible development of a circular economy in enterprise, and points out the specific content that should be considered in evaluating the industrial chain flexibility of a circular economy. The article also builds the index system that evaluates the development flexibility of a circular economy in enterprise and describes the set of evaluation. On this basis, the article evaluates the development flexibility of a circular economy in enterprise with the method of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. At last, “M Coal Group” is selected as an example to analyze the development flexibility of a circular economy.

articleTitle: Determinants of the technical efficiency for Chinese commercial banks during the financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper examines the technical efficiency and its determinants for 17 Chinese commercial banks in the period 2008 to 2010. The aim of this study is to identify the efficiency change of Chinese banks and what variables determine this change when the worldwide financial crisis is still going on. The stochastic frontier approach is used to estimate technical efficiency scores for the 17 commercial banks, and five determinant variables are introduced into the technical inefficiency regression model to detect the most influential factors. Results show that the efficiencies of state-owned and joint-equity banks are growing steadily, and state-owned banks perform the best and city banks perform the worst. Moreover, the assets quality is more important than the innovation ability during this special period to keep the growth of Chinese commercial banks.

articleTitle: The effects of modular production on the module suppliers' willingness to innovate
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Due to the differences between traditional production mode and modular production mode, the modular enterprises' innovation behavior has been the focus of scholars under the field. This paper discusses and empirical analysis the suppliers' willingness to innovate in the modular production networks. The study found that the maturity of product modularization and the competition between module suppliers do help to promote the module suppliers' willingness to innovate, and the module's specificity, the uncertainty module supplier facing and the stability of contact rules will weaken its willingness to innovate. The study also found that there was no necessarily relationship between the size of the module suppliers and their willingness to innovate. In other words, there was no significant difference on small enterprises, medium-sized enterprises and the big enterprises on the willingness to innovate.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the influencing factors of express company's customer loyalty
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Customer-oriented relationship marketing theory has been recognized among the marketing researchers, maintaining and improving customer loyalty has become more and more important for enterprises. In this paper, the author studied the influencing factors of express company's customer loyalty. After analyzing the relevant literatures on customer loyalty and combining with the express company's industry characteristics, this article summarized seven probable main factors that influence the customer loyalty of express company, proposed eight research hypothesis and then established a conceptual model. 353 valid questionnaires were collected. Through the statistical analysis by SPSS19.0 and AMOS 17.0, the result indicated that customer satisfaction and service quality are two key factors affecting customer loyalty which provide a reference for the managers of express company in actual marketing practice.

articleTitle: Hierarchical optimization in architecture and design of product family
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The architecture and design of product family are the key links during the whole value creation process and the thought and technology of optimization are the important foundation and core framework in the architecture and design. The common single-level programming was used for architecture and design of product family in the past research. So configuration and scaling design and platform and customization design as the core problems in product family optimization were performed respectively by two stages. In this paper the integrated optimization of product family is essentially a hierarchical problem is firstly argued. Then hierarchical optimization in architecture and design is discussed systematically: describing the hierarchical optimization problems exist in architecture and design of product family, constructing a whole method framework for the analysis and solution of these problems including problem classification and classification model, conceptual model and mathematical model of hierarchical optimization, solving method choice for engineering application. At last an application example is given.

articleTitle: Coupling of legitimacy mechanism and efficiency mechanism in enterprise group governance during China's economic transformation: A microanalysis perspective of subsidiary initiative
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Chinese enterprise groups, which are under the transitional economy, are facing to both the institutional pressures from the environment and the pressure of competition of the competitors who have advanced technology. In this condition, an analysis based on efficiency is not enough anymore. Therefore, this paper sets out from a micro-analysis view of subsidiary initiative, applies social capital theory, network theory and the new institution theory to build a theoretical model, which couples legality mechanism and efficiency mechanism, and studies the listed firms among Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 Index from 2003 to 2009. We find that, (1)the intrinsic driving power of the enterprise groups growth is their subsidiaries' initiatives; (2)subsidiaries construct or eliminate their inner network based on efficiency mechanism; and (3)the informal network among a group can help its subsidiaries buffer their institutional pressures. Data evidence supports our argument, that is, during the evolution of Chinese enterprise group, legality mechanism and efficiency mechanism are coupled together. Relative to the standpoint of normal system and efficiency system are separate, our conclusion makes the new institution theory more abundant, and it's significant to enterprise group governance practice.

articleTitle: Earnings management using disposal of assets: Empirical evidence from Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Using Chinese A-shared listed companies from 2009 to 2010 for the study sample, this paper investigates whether managers manipulate earnings through the disposal of non-current assets and which factors affect this behavior. The results show that: when real income is below earnings benchmarks, firms tend to increase earnings through the disposal of assets, and the probability of beat earnings benchmarks through the disposal of assets is negatively associated with the differences between earning benchmarks and real income and non-recurring income and positively with debt-asset ratio. When real income is above earnings benchmarks, firms tend to decrease earnings through the disposal of assets, and the probability of smoothing earnings through the disposal of assets is positively associated with the differences between real income and earnings benchmarks and negatively with debt-asset ratio and non-recurring income. Additionally, we also find that the revenue from disposal of assets in the fourth quarter is significantly higher than any of the other three quarters. This study not only contributes to the literature on real activities manipulation, but also provides a new reference for the evaluation of advantages and disadvantages of the historical cost measurement.

articleTitle: Empirical study on managerial overconfidence and corporate investment decisions—Based on the differences of manager's level
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the development of research on behavioral corporate finance, the irrational behaviors of decision makers have received more attention from scholars around the world. Managerial overconfidence is recognized as an important factor accounting for financial decisions. This paper classifies mangers into three levels, including chairman, CEO and TMT. Through exploring the effect of managerial overconfidence on corporate investment decision for different levels of managers, we find out that the overconfidence of chairman and CEO has a significant effect on investment level and merger decisions, while the overconfidence of TMT only affects investment level and investment cash flow sensitivity. This paper approves the effect of managerial overconfidence vary in different manager levels, thus provides an empirical evidence to regulate managers' irrational behaviors.

articleTitle: An incomplete game analysis on information disclosure of internal control
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper studies under the background of the gradual warming of Chinese Government's attention on the internal control, uses the method of game theory, and analyzes the authenticity of internal control disclosure of listed companies from the view of static game with incomplete information. By analyzing, we find that several factors affect the authenticity of internal control information, they are supervision frequency of regulatory authorities, punishment cost, the cost that listed companies color their internal control information and the degree of adverse effect when false disclosure of internal control is found by regulatory authorities, so institutional arrangements are very important to improve the information disclosure of internal control. Then we analyze the status of China's internal control disclosure system, and compare with the relevant laws and regulations in the USA. With the conclusion by game analysis, we provide several suggestions for regulating the information disclosure of internal control on listed companies.

articleTitle: The society evaluation method based on the correlation coefficient-relative membership degree
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: From the view of the society evaluation for provinces, this paper constructs the society evaluation index system by appropriate comparing and filtering. The correlation coefficient-relative membership degree method is used to combing the different evaluation results. The direction, shape, position of score vectors from provinces is taken into account to determine the final ranking. It solves the conflict of evaluating results by different single evaluation methods, avoids the different single evaluation methods often have entirely different evaluation ranking by evaluating the same object. It applies the correlation coefficient- relative membership degree method to 12 typical provinces in China. According to the result, the ranking of the society for such provinces is obtained; the general conclusions of affecting society of provinces are illustrated.

articleTitle: Do research organizations have generic strategies?: Cases from China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Porter's generic strategies offered a dominant paradigm (Campbell-Hunt, 2000) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> on competition for both business practice and academic study. Nowadays, most research organizations in China have to face competition issues as most businesses do. Can they find out their own generic strategies like Porter's for their survival and development in competitive system? Based on the approach of Porter's generic strategy, this paper discusses the generic strategy model for research organizations. As shown in the model, along with the two dimensions of horizontal difference and vertical difference of intellectual capital, research organizations may handle 3 generic strategies: focus strategy, platform strategy and combination strategy. Organizations stuck in the middle will fall flat and have to look for new approaches to build up their own competitive advantages in the competitive system. Data from 42 public institutes in China indicates that the three generic strategies could be recognized in practice.

articleTitle: Analysis of the major factors affecting Macao's economy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As one of the few mini-economic systems in the world, Macao's economic development exhibits not only the common characteristics of the mini-economic system (e.g., sensibility to the external environment), but also its own unique characteristics (e.g., relying on the support of the mainland). Since the return of Macao to China in 1999, Macao's economy has been developing rapidly. Therefore, the influential factors that affect Macao's economy have also been changed. This paper applies the beta regression model to establish Macao's economic growth model. Based on the quarterly data of 2001∼2011, this paper estimates the probability distribution of Macao's GDP growth rates. And according to the model, this paper analyzes the major factors affecting Macao's economic growth.

articleTitle: Effects of diversified strategic resource configuration on corporate performance: Evidence from listed companies in pharmaceutical and biotech industry in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Without a clear consensus of the relationship between diversification strategy and corporate performance, this paper, with annual financial report data of listed companies in pharmaceutical and biotech industry in China from the year 2003 to the year 2009 as sample, investigated the impact and the timing lag of diversified resources configuration, namely, focus level, related diversification level and vertical integration level, on corporate performance, using the polynomial distributed lag (PDL) data model. The empirical results indicate that different way of resource configuration has different influence on corporate performance. And the link between the resource configuration and ROA may reverse over time. Focus level is positively correlated with ROA in the early stage of resource configuration, but negatively with time extension; related diversification level is negatively related with ROA in the short run, but positively with time goes on. Vertical integration level is positive with ROA in the long run. There shows no significant reverse of link between resource configuration and RGR over time.

articleTitle: Measurement of the energy saving rate of technological progress
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Technical progress is so complicated to measure that we are difficult to determine the contribution rate of technological progress to the changes of energy efficiency. After calculating energy saving amount and energy saving rate, this research puts forward measurement method of the energy saving rate of technological progress, and measures Chinese energy saving rate of technological progress based on Chinese data since reform and opening up. We conclude that the meaning of energy saving is similar to energy efficiency, and the mechanism of technological progress to improve energy efficiency is that all of the technical means and measures make the energy demand of additional unit output reduce. The energy saving rate of technological progress is proportional to per capita capital growth rate, but inversely proportional to per capita energy consumption growth rate. Results indicate that the energy saving rate of technological progress is 2.4%, the contribution rate of technological progress to Chinese energy saving rate is 60%, and technological progress has significantly improved energy efficiency.

articleTitle: The research on cultural property right exchange guarantee business risk
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article is based on the rapid development of cultural industries and the establishment of the Cultural Assets and Equity Exchange. Cultural Assets and Equity Exchange secured transactions function as an intermediary platform, and the introduction of VAR model exploratory analysis of the pricing issues of cultural property transactions secured transactions, so as to make quantification of the exchange-traded risk of cultural property as a security platform. The purpose of implements the cultural industry risk management is to prevent loss occurs before accident, mitigate the loss in accident, and compensate the loss after accident. The establishment of an effective risk control mechanism is extremely important to the rise of cultural industries. Sound risk control mechanism for the cultural industry should include the prevention and control strategies, subjects, and means.

articleTitle: The effects of overconfidence on the medium evaluation process of investment project: Evidence from a process tracing experiment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper examines the effects of overconfidence on the medium evaluation process of investment project by a process tracing experiment. The results show that: overconfident has no significant effect on the quantity of browsed information and the content of the information that concerned, but affect the time used to browse the information, the extend and the direction were moderated by the investment performance after one phrase. The overconfident participants have higher evaluation of the investment project than rational ones, but there is no significant difference in the final evaluation. The overconfidence are more inclined to maintain the original evaluation than that of rational ones. When the investment performance is vague, there is significant difference in the final decision between the overconfidence who overestimated the investment income and the rational ones, less overconfident ones abandon the investment project.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of low administration governance: Benefits and risks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper introduces in low administration governance index (LAC, 2005–2007) to measure it's benefits and risks. The OLS regression results indicate that LAC decreases year by year, which confirms the previous statement about governance transition; large companies tend to have higher LAC and take Boards as the main channel. Furthermore, the findings show that LAC has positive associations with the size of companies and the proportion of shares held by the biggest shareholder. Moreover, companies with higher LAC appear to perform worse in financial reporting and stock market performance, which supports the view of LAC-risk. The ratio of debt to total assets is positively associated with LAC, which confirms the LAC-benefit view about the preferential treatment. The total results show that low administration governance have dual impacts of on the performance of non-state owned companies.

articleTitle: Applying modified KMV model to analyze the credit risk of listed firms in Chinese cement industry
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Cement industry is the mainstay industry in China. The development of cement industry is highly correlated with the national economic development. However, cement industry requires a huge capital injection and financing is more difficult for this industry. So, the credit risk management of this industry is becoming a fundamental and crucial work. In this paper, we develop a novel model based on the original KMV model to measure the credit risk of Chinese cement industry. By adjusting some parameters in the basic model, we improve the predictive accuracy and find the adjusted model is more suitable for the cement industry in China. The KMV model assumes that the firm goes into bankruptcy with its default point at short-term debt plus half of the long-term debt. However, by using significance test of the difference of DD (default distance), we think default point in cement industry should be short-term debt plus 10% long-term debt. In addition, we think the value of the company's equity should include both tradable shares and limit sell shares and we find a way to calculate the value of the limit sell shares. Finally, by analyzing the total asset value, DD and EDF (expected default frequency) of 4 selected firms from year 2006 to 2011, we find financial crisis has great impact on Chinese cement industry. However, in the year 2009 and 2010, the large range of the establishment of the economic affordable housing and low-rent housing in China gives cement industry a chance to improve their products' quality and change their strategy to better meet the challenges in the future.

articleTitle: On the embodied energy estimation and analysis of the exported products of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Using an input-output method and proper models and based on data related to the quantity of the exported products on the input-output tables of Beijing in 1997, 2000, 2002, 2005 and 2007 and to the total energy consumptions of Beijing on the China Energy Statistical Yearbooks of the corresponding years, as well as such data as the industrial energy consumption, the GDPs and the export volumes, this paper, through calculation, obtains the embodied energy intensities of different sectors of Beijing and the embodied energy of the exported products of Beijing. According to the empirical results, in Beijing, the embodied energy of the exported products increased with years, and the embodied energy export of the energy-intensive products took a large proportion; the huge export volume of the non-energy-intensive products promoted the increase of the embodied energy of the exported products of Beijing. Furthermore, this paper also gives relevant suggestions.

articleTitle: Influence analyses of social factors on the abilities of university administrative staff
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 19th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The author of this paper believes that it is important to make analyses and researches on the influence factors of university administrative staff as human resource is one of the key factors that decide the future of our course and university administrative staff determine university construction and development.
